verdict.rationale: An integration catalog is a fair question for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never documents a catalog of hundreds or thousands of third-party app and API integrations. The '90+ providers' figure covers LLM model routing, not app integrations. MCP client support and webhook/polling subscriptions are developer building blocks for wiring up integrations yourself, not a ready-made catalog.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
